Name of the Surah

• It is called Al-Fil (The Elephant), because it mentions the story of the Elephant and its companions. The word "al-fil" (the elephant) is not mentioned in any surah other than this one.

From the Objectives of the Surah

• It recounts the story of the Companions of the Elephant, who came to Makkah intending to demolish the Ka'bah, and how Allah destroyed them. In this is a demonstration of Allah's power and the weakness of the oppressors, an affirmation of the sanctity of the Ka'bah and Allah's protection of it, and a strengthening of the Prophet (ﷺ) so that the assault of the polytheists against him does not weaken him.

[The Tafsir]

Have you not considered, O Messenger, how your Lord dealt with the Companions of the Elephant: Abraha the Abyssinian and his army, who intended to destroy the blessed Ka'bah?

Commentary of King Fahd Complex (al-Tafsir al-Muyassar) on surah 105, verse 2:

Did He not make what they plotted of evil into nullification and waste?
And He sent against them birds in successive flocks, pelting them with stones of hardened clay.
